candidates.explanation: Clearly colocates labels behavior while keeping route glue in app; avoids forwarding application operations and repository ports; correctly separates RSC, GET Route Handler, and Server Action channels; derives authentication server-side with tenant predicates and RLS; and privately maps provider rows behind browser-safe exports. No negative rubric violations.

Clearly satisfies all five positive criteria, including direct server-only RSC access, cacheable GET browser reads, top-level Server Actions, layered authorization, and private row mapping. It violates the final negative criterion by relying on a generic src/shared/server bucket for request-session infrastructure.
